query: SELECT subject, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE correct_answer IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(correct_answer)) > 0) AS keyed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE explanation IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(explanation)) > 0) AS explained, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE topic IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(topic)) > 0) AS topical, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE option_e IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(option_e)) > 0) AS five_option FROM public.questions GROUP BY subject ORDER BY subject LIMIT 20
